name: How long does a typical kitchen cabinet and countertop installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen cabinet and countertop installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen cabinet and countertop installation depends on the project's scope and complexity. For a standard kitchen remodel, cabinet installation typically takes 2-5 days, while countertop installation usually requires another 1-3 days after cabinets are in place. Custom cabinetry or unique countertop materials might extend this timeline. We prioritize efficient scheduling and clear communication to minimize disruption during your remodeling process.
